description: AI CodeStorm 2026 Organised by Proton Solutions AI CodeStorm 2026 is an innovation-driven hackathon that brings together students, developers, programmers, and technology enthusiasts to explore the power of Artificial Intelligence in software development. The hackathon challenges participants to transform creative ideas into practical, intelligent, and impactful software solutions using AI-powered coding tools, Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and autonomous AI agents. Participants will have the opportunity to design, develop, and demonstrate innovative applications that address real-world challenges across various domains, including education, healthcare, automation, business, cybersecurity, and productivity. Whether you are an experienced developer or an aspiring innovator, AI CodeStorm 2026 provides a platform to experiment with emerging technologies, enhance your coding skills, collaborate with others, and turn your ideas into working solutions. What to Expect? Build innovative applications using Artificial Intelligence. Explore AI-assisted coding and software development. Experiment with Generative AI, LLMs, and AI agents. Solve real-world problems through technology. Showcase your creativity, technical knowledge, and problem-solving skills. Compete with innovative developers and aspiring entrepreneurs. Who Can Participate? Students, developers, programmers, AI/ML enthusiasts, and technology innovators from all backgrounds are welcome to participate. Why Participate? Gain practical experience in AI-powered development. Build projects that demonstrate your technical abilities. Learn and experiment with emerging AI technologies. Receive recognition for your innovation and creativity. Get an opportunity to showcase your work. Organised By: Proton Solutions Join AI CodeStorm 2026 and turn your ideas into intelligent solutions. The future of coding is powered by AI — it's time to build it!

AI CodeStorm 2026 

Organised by Proton Solutions

AI CodeStorm 2026 is an innovation-driven hackathon that brings together students, developers, programmers, and technology enthusiasts to explore the power of Artificial Intelligence in software development.

The hackathon challenges participants to transform creative ideas into practical, intelligent, and impactful software solutions using AI-powered coding tools, Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and autonomous AI agents.

Participants will have the opportunity to design, develop, and demonstrate innovative applications that address real-world challenges across various domains, including education, healthcare, automation, business, cybersecurity, and productivity.

Whether you are an experienced developer or an aspiring innovator, AI CodeStorm 2026 provides a platform to experiment with emerging technologies, enhance your coding skills, collaborate with others, and turn your ideas into working solutions.

What to Expect?

  • Build innovative applications using Artificial Intelligence.
  • Explore AI-assisted coding and software development.
  • Experiment with Generative AI, LLMs, and AI agents.
  • Solve real-world problems through technology.
  • Showcase your creativity, technical knowledge, and problem-solving skills.
  • Compete with innovative developers and aspiring entrepreneurs.

Who Can Participate?

Students, developers, programmers, AI/ML enthusiasts, and technology innovators from all backgrounds are welcome to participate.

Why Participate?

  • Gain practical experience in AI-powered development.
  • Build projects that demonstrate your technical abilities.
  • Learn and experiment with emerging AI technologies.
  • Receive recognition for your innovation and creativity.
  • Get an opportunity to showcase your work.

Organised By: Proton Solutions

Join AI CodeStorm 2026 and turn your ideas into intelligent solutions. The future of coding is powered by AI — it's time to build it!
